ja: クリリンがパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
様々な劇中再現が可能なクリリンがラインアップ！マッスルをビルドせよ！
• 特徴的な額の6つの模様も差し込みパーツで再現！細かなディテールまでビルド可能！
• 表情パーツは、「通常」、「怒り」、「驚き」の3種付属！色んなシーンを再現しよう！
• エフェクトパーツには必殺技の「気円斬」と「連続気功波」を付属でクリリンの技の豊富さを余すことなく楽しめる！
• 発売中のFigure-riseStandard 人造人間18号と併せて、あの名シーンも再現可能！
en: Krillin is now available with a new package! !
A lineup of Krillin that can be recreated in various ways from the movie! Build muscle!
• The six distinctive forehead patterns are also reproduced with insert parts! You can build even the smallest details!
• Three types of facial expression parts are included: "normal ", " angry ", and " surprised"! Let's recreate various scenes!
• Effect parts include the special moves "Kienzan " and " Continuous Ki Gong Wave" so you can fully enjoy the richness of Krillin's techniques!
• In conjunction with the currently released Figure-riseStandard Android 18, you can also recreate that famous scene!
